workflow_guid.title: Workflow Guid
workflow_guid.description: GUID of the workflow containing the node.

node_guid.title: Node Guid
node_guid.description: GUID of the node containing the entry to move.

source_path.title: Source Path
source_path.description: Current path of the file or folder to move, relative to the node's directory.

target_parent_path.title: Target Parent Path
target_parent_path.description: Destination parent folder path, relative to the node's directory. Omit/None to move to the node's root.

type.title: Type
type.description: Type of entry being moved: "file" or "folder".
